openapi.title: OpenAPI spec
openapi.intro: The full REST API is described in OpenAPI 3.1 format. Import it into Postman, Insomnia, or any HTTP client.

ingest.title: Telemetry address
ingest.intro: Where an application reaches this Thulu from the outside. Agents wiring up telemetry read it from here, so they never have to guess — and the address they can see is rarely the one a deployed application can reach. Leave it empty until you know the answer: unset is a better answer than a wrong one.
ingest.hint_unset: Not set — agents are told the address is unknown.
ingest.install_wide: The telemetry address applies to every workspace on this install.
ingest.label: Address

keys.title: API key
keys.intro: API keys allow programmatic access. Keys are shown only once at creation. A key belongs to this workspace and reaches no other, and it can do only what you tick below.
keys.role_title: How much authority the key has
keys.copy_warning: Copy this key now — it will not be shown again.
keys.no_permissions_picked: Pick what the key may do, or choose a preset.
keys.rotate_title: A new key with the same name, role and permissions; the current one keeps working for a while
keys.rotated: Key rotated: copy the new one now!

run_keys.title: Keys of running runs
run_keys.intro: Each agent run and chat gets its own key, which it revokes when it ends. A key still listed after its run ended is one to revoke.
run_keys.empty: No run holds a key right now.
run_keys.load_failed: Could not load the run keys.
run_keys.revoke_message: The run loses access to the API at once; it fails at its next call.
